ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback on September 23, 2026, acquiring 63,616 equity shares at an average price of ₹297.47, bringing the cumulative total to 1,523,656 shares. This ongoing open market buyback aims to reduce outstanding shares, which typically enhances earnings per share (EPS) and shareholder value. The document is a routine regulatory filing and presents no immediate red flags.
